item.title: Ollama to vLLM: When Your Local Server Needs to Grow Up
item.description: Ollama is the easiest way to run a local model, until the experiment becomes a shared service. Requests queue, latency wobbles, prefixes recompute, and one GPU stops being enough. vLLM answers exactly those problems — but migration is a trade, not an upgrade: simplicity for scheduling, memory control, parallelism, and production operations.

item.title: Claude Code with Local Backends: Install, Config, Ollama, and llama.cpp
item.description: Claude Code isn’t autocomplete with better marketing — it’s a terminal-native junior engineer that needs review. This guide covers install, settings layering, self-hosted Ollama and llama.cpp backends, pricing rails, and troubleshooting.

item.title: Kilo Code: Codebase Indexing with Nomic and Qdrant
item.description: In our previous post, we explored the different modes of Kilo Code. While these modes are powerful, their effectiveness depends on the quality of the context they can access.
